_comment: Claude writes one entry per SWIT ID (cases/apply_text.py merges it). Use real numbers from the SAD constraints and the source constants; state equivalence classes and boundary values inside the steps. design_method lists method names only. Writing an entry for a 'stale' case confirms it was re-checked against the changed anchor.

SWIT-00002.name: DADC_enuGetAdc1SingleAd - converted value reaches HADC
SWIT-00002.target: SWAD-47667: the raw ADC1 group-0 result registered by DADC with the MCAL is returned unchanged to the consumer HADC; invalid channel / NULL pointer are rejected
SWIT-00002.precondition: HADC + DADC linked with real code; MCAL Adc mocked; HADC_vidInit executed with successful calibration so DADC registered its result buffer
SWIT-00002.steps:
1. Write raw value 1000 into the registered buffer at channel Backup_Battery (1)
2. Call DADC_enuGetAdc1SingleAd(1, &out)
3. Call with channel DADC_u16ADC1_NB_VAL (5, first invalid) and with NULL pointer
SWIT-00002.expected: Step 2: LBTY_OK and out == 1000. Step 3: LBTY_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE and LBTY_NULL_POINTER
SWIT-00002.criteria: Return codes and value equal exactly
SWIT-00002.design_method: Requirement analysis, equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis
